description: "The Shadow of Ashlydyat" by Mrs. Henry Wood is a novel written in the early 20th century. The story unfolds in the quaint town of Prior's Ash, introducing us to the Godolphin family, particularly focusing on Sir George Godolphin, who has recently recovered from a long illness, and his children, including the charming George Godolphin and his sisters.
